title: The Best Ugly Christmas Sweaters for Music Fans to Shop Online in 2026
summary: With prices starting at $12, Shop Billboard picked the ugliest Christmas sweaters for all sorts of music fans.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Your favorite band has probably made its way onto a concert tee, hoodie or two, but what about an ugly Christmas sweater? With the holiday season approaching, it’s time to trade your usual music merch for something a little more festive (and a lot more ridiculous).

Ugly Christmas sweaters have become a holiday party staple, and music fans have plenty of options beyond the traditional Santa Claus and reindeer designs. We’re talking classic rock logos covered in snowflakes, hip-hop-inspired holiday graphics and musical puns that are just cheesy enough to earn a spot at your next ugly sweater party.

The best part? You don’t have to sacrifice your music taste for holiday spirit. For the lifelong Deadhead , heavy metal fan or anyone who still misses the days when MTV played music videos , there’s a Christmas sweater that deserves a spot alongside your favorite band tees.

And there’s no need to blow your holiday shopping budget, either. The best music-themed ugly Christmas sweaters in Shop Billboard ‘s 2026 roundup start at around $12, with options from Walmart, Etsy, Macy’s and other online retailers. Several are currently on sale, so you can save a little cash during the holiday shopping frenzy.

Shop our picks for the best ugly Christmas sweaters of 2026, including styles inspired by legendary bands and holiday classics.

Sizes: S-5XL

Priced at $36.99 at TV Store Online, the Pink Floyd ugly Christmas sweater is festive and over-the-top, while it features artwork from the band’s iconic album, Dark Side of the Moon — which was released in 1973. It comes in unisex sizes for adults from small to 5XL.

Black Sabbath, Flying Demon

The Black Sabbath ugly Christmas sweater , which is on sale for $48.29 (was $68.99), features the heavy metal band’s classic “Flying Devil” logo, which is affectionately named “Henry” by fans. It comes in black, white and purple, while it’s marked down to 30% off its list price.

Elf Road Crosswalk

Sizes: S-4XL

$49.95

Buy Now at Walmart

The iconic album cover for Abby Road from The Beatles has been holiday-fied with this Ugly Christmas Sweater (the name of the brand) on Walmart. Priced at $49.96, the “Fab Four” has been transformed into four stylish and groovy elves with this Elf Road Crosswalk sweater .

Wu-Tang Clan, Snowflakes

C.R.E.A.M. now stands for “Christmas Rules Everything Around Me” with this Wu-Tang Clan Ugly Christmas Sweater . It features a lot of the hip-hop group’s classic logo placed with snowflakes and pine trees for the holiday season. It’s on sale for $48.29 (was $68.99), a 30% savings.

Ozzy Osbourne, Merry Christmas

$41.95

For fans of Ozzy Osbourne, this ugly Christmas sweater is a must. It’s priced at $41.95 at Walmart and comes in various sizes from small to 5XL. The sweater is the best way for fans to wish other “Merry Christmas” from the “The Prince of Darkness.”

All I Want For Christmas Is Riley Green

$33.99

The holiday season for country music fans isn’t complete without this ugly Christmas Sweater that proclaims, “ All I Want For Christmas Is Riley Green .” It’s available at Walmart with prices starting at $33.99 in a wide range of sizes from small to 4XL.

KISS Band, Christmas Edition

KISS may be known for their theatrical stage costumes, but this holiday sweater gives the band’s signature look a festive makeover. The green-and-black design features portraits of the original lineup alongside snowflakes, reindeer and repeating KISS logos.

Aerosmith, Wings

$29.95 $68.99 57% off

Aerosmith fans can rock around the Christmas tree in this festive sweater featuring the band’s iconic winged logo. The red, black and blue design is decorated with snowflakes, Christmas trees and geometric patterns. It’s currently 57% off, bringing the price down to $29.95 from $68.99.

Grateful Dead, Dancing Bears

Sizes: S-3XL

This Grateful Dead ugly Christmas sweater brings the band’s psychedelic spirit to the holiday season with its iconic Dancing Bears and Steal Your Face graphics. The red, green and white design is currently 30% off, dropping from $68.99 to $48.29.

Rock Jingle Bell Christmas

$12.49 $16.99 26% off

Buy Now at etsy

Check out a new spin on “Jingle Bell Rock” with this funny holiday sweatshirt. The bright green design pairs Dwayne “The Rock” Johnson’s smiling face with a Santa hat, snowflakes and Christmas trees. It’s currently on sale for 25% off, starting at $12.49.

Fifth Sun MTV Plaid Christmas Crew Fleece Pullover

$44.95

Buy Now at macy's

The days of watching music videos on MTV might feel like a distant memory, but this Christmas sweatshirt brings back a little of that nostalgia. The white fleece pullover is decorated with the network’s classic logo in holiday plaid, complete with a Santa hat. It’s available for $44.95.

Joy Tuba World

$34.95

The holidays are sounding a little different this year. This “Joy Tuba World” sweatshirt is a fun nod to the classic Christmas carol, complete with a tuba graphic, snowflakes and reindeer. It’s available for $34.95 on Etsy.

Meanwhile, last-minute shopping can be frustrating for the holidays, but it helps to have a plan in place. When shopping online, you’ll want to factor in shipping deadlines so that your gift gets delivered in time. The holidays fall on Friday, Dec. 25, so it’s best to get your gifts shipped as soon as possible, or at least by Dec. 13-14, which is the delivery deadline for most online retailers.
